summary.text: Tonya Anderson, a Democrat, represents Georgia Senate District 43 and was sworn in to the Senate on January 9, 2017.

paragraphs.text: Before that she served in the Georgia House of Representatives, sworn in January 14, 2013, and earlier as a city councilwoman and mayor of Lithonia.
She retired in 2012 from the U.S. Air Force Reserve after more than 21 years of service.
